model: UbiquiSTAT commercial BACnet thermostat (US4010 / US4020 / US4040 / US4050)
equipment_type: Thermostat (commercial RTU / heat pump, BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: TCS Basys Controls UbiquiSTAT touchscreen thermostats: US4010 single-stage RTU/zoning, US4020 multi-stage RTU, US4040 advanced RTU and US4050 advanced application.
summary: UbiquiSTAT is a touchscreen thermostat for conventional, heat pump and modulating RTU and zoning applications, with BACnet MS/TP (or TCSbus/Modbus) on RS-485. Appendix A of the product manual lists 244 objects: occupancy schedule and calendar, setpoint pairs, staging, fan, occupancy overrides, sensor inputs and BMS-writable sensor values, relay and analog outputs, economizer, demand ventilation, limits, service status and display settings. A per-model table shows which objects each model has.
notes: From the product manual Appendix A (Object ID, Name, Description, Default, PV Access, Object Profile, model columns). The appendix pages are rotated; text was read by word position.
Access: R/W in the PV Access column = W; objects with a Commandable profile = C; others R. PV Access also says whether the value is stored in RAM or non-volatile memory (NVM).
Objects not available on every model carry the model list in the description, e.g. [US4040/US4050 only].
BSV-1120 and BSV-1200 are BitString Value objects (type listed as Other) with the bit meanings in the states field. The device object itself is not listed.
The newer 2022 product manual drops this appendix and refers to a separate BACnet Explorer guide; this list is from the older manual (v0717.2) hosted by Kele.

source.title: UbiquiSTAT Commercial BACnet Thermostat Product Manual, Appendix A BACnet object list

integration.summary: Set the RS-485 mode to BACnet, the MS/TP address and baud rate on the thermostat (device instance defaults to vendor ID 496 combined with the address), then command occupancy with MSV 700 or the schedule SCH 800 and write the setpoints. Read space temperature, system state and the outputs.
integration.heartbeat: Commands written at priority 10 are relinquished automatically after PIV 401 Command Override Timeout (default 600 s, 0-604800 s); rewrite them before it expires or use another priority.
integration.remote_sensors: Space temperature, discharge, outdoor and mixed air temperature, CO2 and RH (AV 130-135) are commandable, so a BMS can supply them; MSV 120-123 choose the source for space temperature, mixed air, CO2 and RH.
setup: BACnet MS/TP default baud 38,400 bps (TCSbus defaults to 9,600).
Device instance default combines the TCS vendor ID (496) with the network address; set your own unique numbers.
RS-485 address, baud and mode are also objects (PIV 603, MSV 601, MSV 602).
gotchas: Many objects are stored in non-volatile memory (NVM); avoid writing those cyclically.
Check the model columns: over 40 % of objects exist only on some models.
